messages:
Grace L: quick ops thread — planning a 2-week operational sprint to tighten SI co-sell handoffs for HW+marketplace bundles. want a lightweight, runnable playbook not a 10-page doc.
Omar H: love that. propose 3 artifacts: 1) routing priority table, 2) claim lifecycle states, 3) notif templates + SLAs. can we keep ACV thresh = 50k for SI-claim auto?
Nadia V: ACV 50k seems reasonable for most HW deals. add exception for strategic accounts (tag: strategic) -> manual ops review.
Kai M: also require a "hw_needs_site_survey" flag to block auto-assign to SI until validation. we had a bad case where SI accepted but site unsupported.
partner-ops-bot: New sprint ticket created: OPS-SPRINT-19. automatic reminders: daily @10am and sprint retro @end. :white_check_mark:
Grace L: routing priority sketch (short):
```text
1) AE_owner present AND recent_contact<10d -> AE_primary
2) named_account AND ACV>=50000 -> SI_claim_queue
3) marketplace_tagged && !named -> market_discovery_queue
4) hw_site_survey_required -> hw_validation_hold
```
Omar H: claim lifecycle (we'll implement states in routing service): PENDING -> ASSIGNED -> ACCEPTED -> VALIDATED -> ESCALATED -> CLOSED. add timestamps for each state and who acted.
Nadia V: SLA bullets: ASSIGNED -> SI must ACCEPT within 48h or auto-escalate to partner-leads; VALIDATION window for hw = 72h; if AE recently contacted, system waits 24h before broker.
Kai M: overlap logic: if AE/SE contacted primary contact in last 14d -> annotate claim recent-contact=true and route back to AE. if AE declines, then open SI broker.
Grace L: multi-SI interest: open 36h broker window, partners can accept or pass. if multiple accept, run quick scoring: relationship*3 + capacity*2 + region_match*1. winner gets assignment; tie -> rotation fallback.
marketplace-bot: Automated claim: "Helio Systems" -> partner_queue. claim_id=CLM-6610. Notified: @GraceL @partner-ops. :robot_face:
Omar H: notif templates (short): DM to AE: "You have a co-sell claim for <acct>. Claim_id=<id>. If you want ownership, reply in 24h or system will route to partners." Public post: "Claim created: <acct> -> <queue>. ops will assign within SLA."
Nadia V: escalation path: after SLA -> partner-leads -> then sales leadership if unresolved in another 48h. log all notifications in claim audit trail.
Kai M: ops impl note: add claim "why" string to explain decision (e.g., "Assigned to NorthPeak (ACV>=50k, verified-install)"). very helpful for partners.
Grace L: ok ppl — can someone own the one-pager + sample notif snippets for the vendor sync next Tue? aim to run pilot with 6 accounts during sprint. short checklist in bullet form only.
Nadia V: i'll draft the one-pager + snippets today.
Omar H: i'll add lifecycle enum in routing service and PR the overlap + SLA timers.
Kai M: i'll prepare hw-validation checklist and sample site-survey form.
partner-ops-bot: Sprint kickoff scheduled: OPS-SPRINT-19 starts tomorrow. reminders set. :rocket:
Grace L: thanks team — keeping it tight and practical. we'll iterate from pilot feedback. :thumbsup:
